root_cause.text: The partial overlap detection logic in the `__nft_rbtree_insert` function of the `nft_set_rbtree` netfilter subsystem completely bypassed checks on start elements for anonymous sets, allowing overlapping intervals with the same start element to be inserted.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of the `!nft_set_is_anonymous(set)` condition that previously skipped the overlap check for anonymous sets, and replaces it with a check using `nft_rbtree_prev_active()` to ensure a new start element does not fall between existing start and end elements.

intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce a helper function to retrieve the previous active element in an nftables rbtree to support insertion logic.
intent_record.what: Introduces a new helper function `nft_rbtree_prev_active` to retrieve the previous node in the red-black tree and declares a new local variable `rbe_prev` in `__nft_rbtree_insert`.
intent_record.how: Provides a mechanism to safely look up the preceding active element in the tree for anonymous sets, preparing the insertion function to use this reference during tree traversal.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix partial overlap detection for anonymous sets in nft_rbtree by validating that new start elements do not lie within an existing interval.
intent_record.what: Modified the interval overlap check in `__nft_rbtree_insert` to perform validation on anonymous sets instead of skipping them entirely, adding a check to see if the previous active element is an end interval.
intent_record.how: Ensures that for anonymous sets, a new start element cannot be inserted between an existing start and end element, returning -ENOTEMPTY to prevent partial overlaps while still allowing valid consecutive start elements.
